sources.relevance: New GA product (April 2026): universal context engine for AI agents built on Dataplex. New reference implementation for catalog and context products.

sources.relevance: Unity AI Gateway and Governance Hub announcements. Relevant to catalog, context, and governance/gateway products.

sources.relevance: New reference implementation for semantic product. Warehouse-native semantic layer consumed by Cortex Agents.

sources.relevance: Semantic View Autopilot (Feb 2026): AI-assisted semantic model generation. New capability: semantic_autopilot.

sources.title: Graph RAG and Knowledge Graphs: The New Standard for Enterprise AI Search in 2026
sources.relevance: Architecture guide for Graph RAG in enterprise. Supports graph_retrieval and knowledge_graph_repository capabilities.

sources.title: Microsoft GraphRAG Project
sources.relevance: Open-source reference implementation for knowledge graph construction and hierarchical RAG retrieval.

sources.title: Permission-Aware Retrieval: Why Access Control in Enterprise RAG Must Live in the Vector Layer
sources.relevance: Architecture rationale for permission-aware retrieval at vector layer. Supports retrieval product capability hardening.

sources.title: Securing the Agent: Vendor-Neutral, Multitenant Enterprise Retrieval and Tool Use
sources.relevance: Academic paper on secure multi-tenant enterprise RAG. Supports query_decomposition and permission_aware_retrieval capabilities.

sources.relevance: Market overview positioning Atlan as context layer governing AI agent consumption of semantic definitions. Relevant to catalog and semantic products.

sources.relevance: June 2026 analysis. Governance rationale for semantic layer in enterprise AI. Supports semantic and definition products.

sources.title: Knowledge Graph RAG: Agentic Crawling and Graph Construction in Enterprise Documents
sources.relevance: Research on agentic knowledge graph construction from enterprise documents (March 2026). Supports knowledge_graph_repository and graph_retrieval capabilities.

sources.relevance: Fully managed agentic platform using Semantic Views for governed analytics. Reference implementation for semantic product.

sources.title: Enterprise Knowledge Agents: What Comes After Search
sources.relevance: May 2026 analysis of knowledge agent trend in financial services. Context for knowledge product evolution.
